verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Postman can run collections on demand through the Postman CLI or Newman, plug into CI/CD pipelines, and build visual API workflows. Nothing in the pack documents a native way to schedule those runs on a recurring basis. Running collections from a CI/CD pipeline is a user-side or host-platform arrangement, and a one-off run is not a recurring schedule, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
